early-church.label: Early Church
early-church.description: The apostolic age through the age of the Church Fathers and the great councils — roughly the first six centuries, up to about 600 AD.

medieval.label: Medieval
medieval.description: The Middle Ages, roughly 600 to 1500 — the age of monasticism, the mendicant orders, and the scholastics.

early-modern.label: Early modern
early-modern.description: Roughly 1500 to 1800 — the Reformation, the Catholic Reformation, and the great missionary expansion.

modern.label: Modern
modern.description: Roughly 1800 to the present — from the industrial age through the Second Vatican Council and our own day.
